parsed.attack: The pain is asserted as a structural fact about the category rather than quoted from anyone, and the free substitute is already universal: two parents share one login, which costs nothing, works today, and is what the incumbents quietly tolerate. The window is also self-limiting to twelve weeks by the author's own kill criterion, so a payment habit is being asked of people who will have no use for the product by the time the first renewal lands.
parsed.strongest_defence: Feed logging at 3am is among the most heavily performed behaviours in consumer software, observed at enormous scale across Huckleberry, Baby Tracker and Glow: these parents are already doing the work every night, unprompted, and the partial-log complaint is one of the most repeated reviews in the category - this is revealed demand, not a stated wish.
parsed.verdict_reason: The logging behaviour is performed nightly at volume by millions of people with no prompting, which is as close to felt rather than stated demand as this category offers.
